LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsEnableDraftedWeaponPoseOffs: Use drafted goblin weapon pose adjustments
When disabled, drafted pawns at rest use vanilla weapon positioning. Attack poses, spear thrusts, throws and charges are unchanged.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsPassingGroupFrequencyDesc: Adjusts the frequency of traveler groups and MUGB wandering beggars. Kim Deok-pal produces them slightly more often.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsPawnLossAdaptationDescripti: 0%: no colonist-loss raid relief. 50%: half vanilla relief. 100%: vanilla.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsEnableGoblinSquadSystemDesc: Uses squad templates to compose regular goblin raids while preserving their selected raid strategy and arrival mode.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsEnableGoblinCompositeRaidsD: Allows large goblin raids to split into a sapper force and a conventional assault force approaching from two directions.
LanguageData.MUGB_AllowFacialAnimationForGoblinsDesc: Off by default. When off, goblins are excluded from [NL] Facial Animation's face replacement and keep their goblin faces. When on, Facial Animation replaces goblin faces with its humanlike animated faces, which may look broken.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningUseTextureColors: Use texture colors without skin tint
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningUseTextureColorsDesc: Enable this when the body, head, and ear textures already contain their intended colors. Disabling it reapplies the vanilla skin tint.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningMoveHeadgear: Move headgear with tuned head position
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningMoveHeadgearDesc: Applies the tuned head position to vanilla and modded headgear as well.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningForceBaldDesc: Hides goblin hair and beards. Disable this to allow players to assign hair or beards to goblins.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningHarHeadExemptionDesc: Goblins keep their intended head size even when a mod that resizes human heads (such as Hooman cute) is active. Goblin face parts are positioned for the original head size, so leaving this on is recommended.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningAddonFollowHead: Move face parts with head size
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningAddonFollowHeadDesc: Used when the head size lock above is off. Ears, eyes, nose and mouth move by the same amount the head was resized, preserving their proportions. Has no effect while the head size lock is on.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningRenderScaleDesc: VEF render scale. This changes the pawn render scale path, not the raw texture graphic size.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningHeadBodyGlobalDesc: Adjust these first, then use small directional corrections only when needed.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningPawnAltitudeDesc: Advanced: adjusts the entire goblin render root relative to other pawns.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningAddonGlobalDesc: Adjust these before per-part or per-form tuning.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningDirectionalFineDesc: Select a form, part, and direction below. West is separate when west-facing textures exist.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningSelectRacePawn: Selected-race tuning: select an adult non-HAR humanlike pawn.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningVisualCopied: MUGB visual tuning copied to clipboard.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningApparelIntro: Tune wearable headgear or apparel by ThingDef. Values are saved in mod settings.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningApparelPreviewDesc: The preview can temporarily display equipment the selected pawn does not own or wear.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningApplyScaleAllDesc: Applies only equipment scale to south, north, east, and west at once. Position and layer remain direction-specific.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningMirrorEastWestDesc: When tuning east or west, saves the opposite direction with mirrored X and matching Y, scale, and layer values.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningCopySelectedApparel: Copy selected item tuning to clipboard
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningSelectedApparelCopied: MUGB selected apparel tuning copied to clipboard.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningCopyAllApparel: Copy all apparel tuning to clipboard
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningAllApparelCopied: MUGB apparel tuning copied to clipboard.
LanguageData.MUGB_TuningExportAllApparel: Export all apparel tuning to TXT
LanguageData.MUGB_DisableToxicPheromonesCheatDesc: Disables goblin toxic pheromones. Non-goblins are unaffected and performance improves very slightly. Relic staves are the intended solution.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsGoblinLitterSizeExpected: Expected litter - Thin father: {0}, Hob father: {1}
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsGoblinLitterSizeDesc: Applies when a new pregnancy begins. Existing pregnancies keep their current litter.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsGoblinChildStageDaysDesc: Time for a pure goblin child to reach age 13. Zero skips the child stage.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsGoblinBabyStageDaysDesc: Time a newborn pure goblin spends as a baby before becoming a child. Choose none, 0.5, 1, 2 or 3 days. None means goblins are born at age 3 as before. Goblin babies are not swaddled, and colonists will not carry them to safe temperatures.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsGoblinBirthStrainDesc: Number of goblin litters a non-goblin mother can deliver before the strain kills her. Lowering the limit never kills a pawn immediately.
